name: The Ledger - reconstructed-participant market simulation
hypothesis: Crypto returns are driven by participant constraint rather than chart shape, so a conserved stock-flow-consistent reconstruction of who holds the coins and who holds the dry powder carries information that candle features do not.
phase: Operator phase 1 of 3 BUILT: the whole record reconstructed, 2017-08-17 to 2025-12-31, 14 assets, live population. Phase 2 (train the behaviour) next; phase 3 (forward-test 2026) after it. The design's eight phases are mapped onto the operator's three in .meshkore/context/system09-design.md and kept in full.
data: Binance 15m candles with taker_buy_volume for all 14 universe assets - the aggressor/passive split, in the catalogue from 2017-08
Binance perpetual funding, 8h, per symbol from 2019-09
oi_BTCUSDT - Binance perpetual open interest, daily from 2020-11, 2143 days (new): anchors the perpetual book
chain_total-bitcoins - Bitcoin circulating supply, daily (new): the only true daily float
circulating_supply.json - snapshot supply for the other 13 assets, held constant (new)
stablecoin_supply - DefiLlama total stablecoin float in USD, daily from 2017-11 (new)
etf_flow_btc - US spot BTC ETF creations and redemptions, US$m, daily from 2024-01 (new): HELD OUT of the reconstruction and used as the V2 anchor
chain_n-unique-addresses - one half of the population driver
NOT USED YET: liquidations, exchange reserves, CME COT, on-chain cost basis

helped.what: Use the existing 15m taker_buy_volume instead of downloading aggTrades
helped.effect: the aggressor/passive split the design calls the spine was already local; the whole build needed zero tape bytes

helped.what: One shared cash pool across all 14 assets
helped.effect: removed the largest fudge of the one-asset MVP, which gave BTC a private share of the sector cash and so invented liquidity

helped.what: Infer the unobserved fiat channel as a residual and report it
helped.effect: PREDICTED IN ADVANCE AND CONFIRMED: 7.5bn in 2017 rising to 84.8bn through 2022, then exactly zero from 2023, when the observed stablecoin float alone funds the entire observed tape

helped.what: Velocity-aware sizing of the fiat ramp
helped.effect: ramping the bare shortfall converges far too slowly; dividing by the demonstrated cash velocity lifted early-record fill from 0.73 to 0.97

helped.what: Allocate flow by desire times capacity rather than desire alone
helped.effect: without it the Zipf size ladder is inert - a bottom rung agent wins the same share as the top rung
the constraint that makes a holder a holder; before it, long-term holders with 60 per cent of the float became the largest day trader in the market

helped.what: Allocate miner selling structurally, before the shared pool
helped.effect: miners were net BUYERS of 105k BTC in H1-2024 while competing for a weighted share; the correct sign was restored once issuance was pre-allocated

helped.what: Renormalise an asset listing float over the cohorts that actually hold it
helped.effect: thinly-held tokens were floating short - Worldcoin arrived two thirds under its real supply

helped.what: Anchor the perpetual book to observed open interest
helped.effect: replaced a constant times a trend with a published series over 2143 days

helped.what: Assert conservation in the hot path rather than in a test
helped.effect: every real bug was caught at the bucket that caused it, with the offending agent named

hurt.what: Bitcoin active addresses as the sole population driver
hurt.effect: the population sat at a constant headcount for the entire eight-year record; that series peaked in 2017 and is blind to exchanges and other chains

hurt.what: The stablecoin float as the second population bracket
hurt.effect: the free series begins at 110,000 dollars in 2017, so every later reading is a millionfold growth and the ladder saturated in its first year
hurt.evidence: preview run, rungs pinned at the ceiling from 2018

hurt.effect: the reconstruction beats the naive baseline on all six FLOW statistics and loses both LEVEL statistics (cumulative pearson 0.906 against 0.981). It knows when institutional money moved, not how much is there.

hurt.what: Alt supply as a held-constant snapshot
hurt.effect: every asset except Bitcoin carries today circulating supply across the whole record; assets still emitting hold too large a float in the early years

hurt.what: Opening cohort priors COIN_PRIOR and CASH_PRIOR
hurt.effect: asserted, not measured; they set the level of every stock, which is exactly where V2 says the reconstruction is weakest

hurt.what: Declaring the V2 verdict on the single best statistic
hurt.effect: the first implementation reported RECOVERED on weekly pearson alone; a vote over all nine reversed it

hurt.what: Long-term-holder turnover cap of 0.2 per cent a day
hurt.effect: far too loose - the cohort shed 2.09M coins in 2021 alone; tightened to 0.03

open.what: Phase 2: train the behaviour instead of asserting it
open.why: every propensity constant is an unfitted prior; the design names simulated minimum distance and neural posterior estimation and neither has been applied.

open.what: The cheap observable-proxy pre-test is still owed
open.why: it was skipped to reach the reconstruction and remains the cheapest test here.

open.what: The reconstruction knows flow better than level
open.why: V2 loses both cumulative statistics, which points at the opening priors rather than at the dynamics.

open.what: The population count is the number least entitled to be believed
open.why: neither observable bracket measures participants; the geometric mean of two wrong things is a prior.

open.what: L2 to L5 do not exist
open.why: no behaviour learning, no market clearing, no forward simulation, no policy.
Binance only; multi-venue and on-chain fusion remain in the design.

rules: A trade redistributes cash inside the ecosystem; it does not add any. Only the boundary - issuance, listings, stablecoin mint and burn, ETF creation, fiat - changes the totals.
Exchange tape is anonymous: participants are latent cohorts pinned by accounting identities and external anchors, never reconstructed wallets.
One wallet, many assets: giving each market its own pile of cash invents liquidity, and competition for one pool is most of what modelling an ecosystem means.
What cannot be observed should be inferred and REPORTED, never assumed. A residual that must fade over time is a falsifiable prediction; an assumption is not.
Check the base of any growth factor before using it as a driver: a series that starts near zero produces an infinite growth rate and saturates whatever it drives.
Wanting and being able to are both required: an allocator that uses capacity only as a cap, never as a weight, silently deletes its own size distribution.
A cohort is defined by its turnover, not only by its opinion.
Forced flow must be allocated before discretionary flow, or a structural seller stops being structural and changes sign.
A held-out anchor is evidence only when scored against the signal that drove the prediction.
Declare a verdict on a vote over every statistic computed, never on the best one.
